description.value: Hoxton Gastown is a comedy-focused bar and restaurant in Vancouver's historic Gastown neighbourhood, offering a chef-driven food menu alongside stand-up shows, weekly trivia nights, and a full bar. The venue doubles as a rentable creative space for film shoots, music videos, private parties, and brand activations. A touring cyclist stopping in Gastown would find a lively, food-forward spot with a distinct comedy-club atmosphere.
